description: We are now just two months from the election. This whole process has been a whirlwind. Seems like there's not enough time to get all the things I wanted to do done. And will it be enough? Does any of it matter? I think so. If nothing else, people can see that we're trying. We're out among the people, because that's what we purport to be doing - representing the people. So, we're listening, observing, asking questions. There is a new generation of Missourians coming of age, and I think it's time
title: Race to the finish
